label: MH9 band5_stronghold_approach_1-day High cand|ship
brief: Fixed production-camera views of the approach to the enemy faction's stronghold in the Meadows (day), with the 1.80 m trainer as a ruler. Judge whether it reads as the key art's Meadows: a coherent place with a readable, dominant landmark, believable ground and light that belongs to the world.
defects: Placeholder or untextured materials (flat grey, checker or faceted blocks)
Floating bodies or props (a gap between an object and the ground under it)
Clipping (geometry passing through geometry, or the camera inside geometry)
P2-003: the stronghold reads as a small dark ruin behind dominant pylons, with no tall lit landmark
the stronghold heraldry reads as giant flat banners rather than war banners on poles with draped cloth
red or oxblood appears on something other than the enemy faction's banners (Team Tether red is reserved for their own heraldry)
